name: Shrimp's Cave
description: Cave on the west side of Reqqa Point, in the same stretch as Billinghurst Cave and Bottleneck Cave, known for the many shrimps inside.
conditions: Sharp rocks at the entry; northerly and westerly winds make getting in and out difficult.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites. Little detailed information found. Position moved just off the west side of Reqqa Point (the source position fell on land).
